gloss: additional goal or run; extra point

definitions.gloss: additional goal or run; extra point
definitions.explanation: A point scored by a team that is already ahead, widening its lead.

examples.japanese: {追加点|ついかてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{待望|たいぼう}→待望：12545_taibou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{追加点|ついかてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
examples.english: The long-awaited second goal came in the second half.
